description: Switch .env loading from custom DotEnvPostProcessor to the spring-dotenv library (springboot4-dotenv v5.1.0)

userStories.title: Remove custom DotEnvPostProcessor implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to delete the custom EPP code so we have no duplicated loading logic when spring-dotenv is added.
acceptanceCriteria: The stale comment in application.properties referencing DotEnvPostProcessor is removed or updated

userStories.title: Add spring-dotenv dependency
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add me.paulschwarz:springboot4-dotenv to pom.xml so the library auto-loads .env at startup.
acceptanceCriteria: me.paulschwarz:spring-dotenv-bom:5.1.0 is added under <dependencyManagement> in pom.xml
me.paulschwarz:springboot4-dotenv (no explicit version, resolved via BOM) is added under <dependencies>
No spring.config.import=dotenv: is needed — the library activates automatically

userStories.title: Verify .env loading with real credentials
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to confirm that the credentials in .env are loaded at startup so that login works with real credentials, not the admin/admin defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Startup log shows real credentials loaded from .env (not the default-credentials warning)
POST /api/auth/login with admin/admin credentials returns 401 (verified by test)
